abstract: The Albert Mathieu Chorionepithelioma Registry's 1800 cases were screened, and 70 cases of trophoblastic disease involving the central nervous system were abstracted. In addition, eight patients with central nervous system trophoblastic disease from the Western Trophoblastic Disease Center, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, University of Southern California (USC) Medical Center, were reviewed. Eighteen patients received chemotherapy and whole-brain irradiation, 25 were treated with chemotherapy alone, and 35 received neither chemotherapy nor irradiation. In the no-treatment group (in which most patients died before therapy was begun), there were no survivors, and 74% of the deaths resulted from central nervous system causes. In the chemotherapy-alone group, 24% survived and 58% died of central nervous system causes. In the chemotherapy and irradiation group, 50% survived but none of the deaths were due to central nervous system involvement. This study suggests that radiation has a distinct therapeutic role in the treatment of central nervous system choriocarcinoma, and provides evidence that the irradiated brain tends to resist recurrent disease even in those patients for whom the outcome is fatal.
abstract_ja: アルバート・マチュー絨毛上皮腫登録の1800例を精査し、中枢神経系に及んだ栄養膜疾患の70例を抽出した。さらに、南カリフォルニア大学(USC)医療センターの西部栄養膜疾患センターにおける中枢神経系栄養膜疾患の8例を検討した。18例は化学療法と全脳照射を受け、25例は化学療法単独、35例は化学療法も照射も受けなかった。無治療群(多くは治療開始前に死亡)では生存者はおらず、死亡の74%は中枢神経系の原因によるものであった。化学療法単独群では24%が生存し、58%が中枢神経系の原因で死亡した。化学療法と放射線療法の併用群では50%が生存し、死亡のいずれも中枢神経系の関与によるものではなかった。本研究は、中枢神経系絨毛癌の治療において放射線療法が明確な治療的役割を持つことを示唆する。また、照射を受けた脳は、致命的な転帰となった症例においてさえ再発に抵抗性を示すことが示唆された。
